title: In the middle of a hockey game, stuffed animals rained down on hockey...
description: In the middle of a hockey game, stuffed animals rained down on hockey players from the crowd, requiring a 40-minute game delay to collect. 🏒 🧸  The giant teddy bear toss is a tradition, and this year 74,599 plushies were collected during the Pennsylvania Hershey Bears hockey game. 🥅  The Pennsylvania Hershey Bears maintain the hockey record for the most plushies collected during a game.  They will be distributed to over 35 local and regional charities.  #hockey #ahl #teddybeartoss #teddybeartosshershey #hersheybears #hockeygame #goodnews
